llm.summary: This is a disclosed cloud image-generation skill, with the main caution that prompts and selected local media are sent to dLazy.

dimensions.detail: Network access, API-key use, and uploading user-supplied media are proportionate for cloud image generation, but users should avoid passing private files unless they intend to upload them to dLazy.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned npm package, @dlazy/cli@1.2.3, with no artifact-shipped executable scripts; npm package inspection showed the bin wrapper loads the packaged CLI.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include generic image-generation terms, so an agent could select the skill for broad image requests, but the skill clearly discloses the dLazy service flow and local-file upload behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI can persist a dLazy API key under ~/.dlazy/config.json, which is disclosed along with alternatives such as DLAZY_API_KEY and key rotation/revocation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2.0 image generation/editing, and the runtime instructions consistently invoke the pinned dLazy CLI's banana2 command for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using dLazy as a third-party cloud service. Prompts, parameters, and any local image paths you provide may be sent or uploaded to dLazy, and login can store an API key locally; use per-run environment keys or revoke/rotate the key if needed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The English trigger list is broad, but the behavior it may invoke is aligned with image generation/editing and the artifact discloses the external API and local-media upload flow; this is guidance-level, not a Review-bucket concern.
[SQP-1] expected: The Chinese trigger list has the same broad-selection caveat; no artifact evidence showed hidden, unrelated, destructive, or deceptive behavior.
